about_the_game:
Hit & Haunted is a murder mystery investigation game, except you’re not a detective. Instead, you play as two characters: Eli, the ghost of the victim; and Ace, the hitman who killed him. This unlikely duo must work together to find the anonymous client who hired the hit so that Eli can move on to the afterlife, and more importantly, stop haunting Ace. (This is made a bit more difficult by the fact that Eli doesn’t remember much about his life, because, you know, Ace shot him in the head.)

Key Features

Switch between Ace and Eli to use their different abilities. Ace is able to interact with other living humans and objects in the living world, while Eli can see and interact with other ghosts and possess objects in the ghost world. Collect information, solve puzzles, and unlock locations to unravel the mystery behind the culprit of Eli’s murder.

content_descriptors.notes:
The player takes control of a hitman and sees them murder someone at the beginning of the game. 

The game may contain content not suitable for all audiences:
Blood.
Violence.
General Mature Content.
